'''R-3PO''',<ref name="AEYNTK">''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]''</ref> also known as "'''R-3'''," was a [[3PO-series protocol droid]] with distinctive deep [[Color|red]] plating, bright yellow [[Photoreceptor|“eye” sensors]],<ref name="KOTOBUKIYA" /> and a moody attitude. During the [[Galactic Civil War]], it served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]]<ref name="ESB" /> and [[Alliance High Command]]<ref name="KOTOBUKIYA jp" /> in their fight against the [[Galactic Empire]], and when the Alliance established [[Echo Base]] on the [[planet]] [[Hoth]], R-3PO was tasked with keeping a lookout for [[Spy|spies]]<ref name="AEYNTK" /> and Imperial [[spy droid]]s<ref name="KOTOBUKIYA jp" /> within the base.<ref name="AEYNTK" /> The [[Protocol droid|droid]] was present for the [[Battle of Hoth]], which the Alliance lost, forcing them to evacuate Echo Base.<ref name="ESB" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Woe is me! A Squadron of our most mediocre Rebels has not returned, and Zev is most upset! I share in his anguish! I hope he brings them back safely. Oh the melancholia!|R-3PO on Aquamarine Squad|<ref name="LSS">''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]''</ref>}}
[[File:R3po_echo_base.png|thumb|right|190px|R-3PO inside Echo Base]]
R-3PO was a background character in [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''The Empire Strikes Back'']], where he is in Echo Base shortly before the Battle of Hoth.<ref name="ESB" /> He also appears in the non-[[canon]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Force Awakens]]'', in which he has been reprogrammed as a droid serving the [[First Order]].<ref name="LEGO">''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Force Awakens]]''</ref> His name originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity via the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]],<ref name="Legends">{{CCG|set=Hoth Limited|cardname=R-3PO (Ar-Threepio)}}</ref> and was brought into the new [[canon]] via ''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]''.<ref name="AEYNTK" /> R-3PO was portrayed by [[Chris Parsons]]<ref>{{Twitter|cparsonsactor|url=status/922850885738401792|name=[[Chris Parsons]]|archiveurl=https://archive.is/7gekR}}</ref>
